verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs describe a cloud agent that can plan, explore, and execute tasks autonomously, run in isolated sandboxes, and be reviewed/merged from a dashboard (github-copilot-docs-3,6,8,14,15,16), matching the build/execute/review portion of the story, but there is no explicit evidence of automated testing or 'demo' generation, and no independent community validation of the cloud-agent feature specifically.
